description: Cancel the current print on a printer

comment.description: Optional comment explaining why the print was cancelled. May be required depending on organization settings.

custom_position.description: Custom sort position when return_position is 'custom'.

reason.description: Cancel reason ID. May be required depending on organization settings.

return_position.description: Position to insert queue item at when returning to queue (original, top, bottom or custom).

return_to_queue.description: Whether to return cancelled queued print to the queue. Uses organization default if not specified.

name: cancel_print
